population: All original 192 M49/M50 inputs, eight frozen M38 shared models, exclusive/shared/union. Perturb only positions whose mapped M50 unit is eligible; keep other positions native. Include zero targets and missing predictor directions.
target: Subtract recipient decoded component from original native MLP1 product write, leaving Down bias and downstream computation intact. Gates and coordinates frozen from unperturbed input.
norm: Every nonzero predictor direction normalized to recipient component norm; zero target stays zero. Missing donor/seen-zero mean stays zero, unseen token uses group mean.
metric: At every original input position, compute native-probability-weighted squared error between predictor and recipient intervention log-probability changes. Sum over vocabulary and positions. Pool numerator and target response energy by model/component/cohort; zero-response error=1 when energy>0. Report unnormalized energies, zero-energy cases, and input-wise win counts. All-position causal effects include propagation from eligible earlier positions.
definition: r_target=logsoftmax(target_logits)-logsoftmax(native_logits); r_pred analogously. numerator=sum p_native*(r_pred-r_target)^2, denominator=sum p_native*r_target^2. Zero predictor uses r_pred=0.
precision: Double precision logsoftmax and response metric; model and interventions float32. Retain exact no-op cases.
controls: Recompute eligible-only teacher; old M49 full-position effects are not interchangeable. Verify saved token table provenance, mapped native input energies, delta additivity before normalization, norm matching, and independent NumPy response metrics on fixed samples.
scope: Conditional response fidelity, not autonomous prediction, not direct neuron redundancy, and not comparison of architecture quality on a common intervention. No new training or reserved task exposure.
stop: One fixed comparison. No magnitude, seed, membership, count threshold, or loss search. Interpret native fidelity separately from local geometry and return findings to broader featurizer/task loop.
